data.name: Opzioni_CheCosEe
data.value: Brings into N.I.N.A. the prescription decided by AstroImage-Strategy: which channels to shoot, how many exposures, what sub length and which gain mode. This bridge decides nothing — it takes a prescription already worked out and builds it in the Advanced Sequencer. It never starts anything: pressing Play is your job.

data.name: Opzioni_ChiLHaFatto
data.value: Author and maintainer: Alessandro Curci. The code was largely written by an artificial intelligence assistant (Claude, by Anthropic), under his direction and his review.

data.name: Opzioni_DoveSiComanda
data.value: Everything is driven from the “AstroImage Strategy” panel, under Imaging: that is where you ask for a prescription, declare which filters you really have in the wheel — once per profile — and deliver the target. This page only holds the language, which instead applies to every profile.

data.name: Opzioni_Lingua
data.value: Language

data.name: Opzioni_LinguaAiuto
data.value: Applies to the panel and to the bridge's own messages, not to N.I.N.A. It is not kept in the profile: it is the same for every site, because the person reading is the same. Out of the box the bridge speaks English.

data.name: Opzioni_LinguaSegui
data.value: Follow N.I.N.A.

data.name: Opzioni_ServeIlMotore
data.value: On its own this plugin does nothing: on the other side there must be AstroImage-Strategy answering on an HTTP port. Without it, the panel opens and tells you the engine is not answering.
